player_prompt.intro:
Amamas long Lights Out! Yu gat wanpela {size}x{size} grid bilong lait.
Mipela pasin bilong yu em long pasim olgeta lait OFF (i makim '.' )
Taim yu pren lait, em i pasim em yet na olgeta narapela lait i stap klostu (antap/dawn/lef/raut).
Taip [row col] long pren lait (0-indexed, olsem valid ranj em 0-{max_index}).
Yu gat inap long {max_turns} muv long solvim puzzle.
Legend: 'O' = lait ON, '.' = lait OFF

board.current_state:
Karent stet bilong grid (Muvm {moves_made}, {moves_left} muv i stap, {completion}% i go kamap):
{grid}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Ol i mas raitim long format [row col] we ol rait na kol em integers namel 0 na {max_index}.
invalid_move.out_of_range: Ko-odinat i mas i stap namel 0 na {max_index}. Yu putim [{row},{col}].

outcome.win: Kongratuleshan! Yu solvim puzzle long {moves_used} muv!
